# X509
# @weight 15
# @timeout-scale 4

Certificates and the chains TLS servers send.  The certificates are the
real ones jrexpr.ca and github.com served on 2026-10-11, leaf first, each
with a cross-signature past its intermediate; the roots are GTS Root R4
and USERTrust ECC from the system's bundle.  The clock is held at
2026-10-15 00:00:00 UTC (1792022400), inside both leaves' validity.  Every
signature on these paths is ECDSA over P-256 or P-384, and the chain
check builds those curves' engines, so the file carries an engine's
weight.

## the fixture

### the chains and the roots

```x
(do
  (import x/net/x509)
  (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def %xc-now 1792022400)
  (def %xc-jr (List map (fn (_ h) (Bytes of-hex h)) (list "" "" "")))
  (def %xc-gh (List map (fn (_ h) (Bytes of-hex h)) (list "" "" "")))
  (def %xc-roots (List map (fn (_ h) (X509 parse (Bytes of-hex h))) (list "" "")))
  (def %xc-why (fn (_ thunk) (guard (e (e msg)) (thunk))))
  (write (List length %xc-roots)))
```
---
    2

## reading a certificate

### the leaf's names, dates and key

```x
(do
  (def %xc-leaf (X509 parse (first %xc-jr)))
  (write (list (X509 dns-names %xc-leaf) (X509 validity %xc-leaf) (first (X509 public-key %xc-leaf))
               (X509 signed-by? %xc-leaf (X509 parse (first (rest %xc-jr))))
               (X509 signed-by? %xc-leaf (first %xc-roots)))))
```
---
    (("jrexpr.ca" "*.jrexpr.ca") (1788650136 1796429729) 'p256 #t #f)

## chains that hold

### jrexpr.ca, by name and by its wildcard, and github.com through its cross-signature

```x
(write (list (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)
             (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "WWW.jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)
             (X509 verify-chain %xc-gh "github.com" %xc-now %xc-roots)))
```
---
    (#t #t #t)

## chains that do not

### the wrong host, a wildcard two labels deep, a later date, no roots, and a leaf with another's intermediates

```x
(write (list (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "example.com" %xc-now %xc-roots)))
             (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "a.b.jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)))
             (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "jrexpr.ca" 1811808000 %xc-roots)))
             (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "jrexpr.ca" %xc-now ())))
             (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain (pair (first %xc-jr) (rest %xc-gh)) "jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)))))
```
---
    ("X509: the server's certificate does not name example.com" "X509: the server's certificate does not name a.b.jrexpr.ca" "X509: the server's certificate is out of date" "X509: no path to a trusted root (an RSA signature on the way is not checked yet)" "X509: no path to a trusted root (an RSA signature on the way is not checked yet)")

### PEM text reads back to the same bytes

```x
(do
  (def %xc-pem (Str8 append "junk\n-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIICCjCCAZGgAwIBAgIQbkepyIuUtui7OyrYorLBmTAKBggqhkjOPQQDAzBHMQsw\nCQYDVQQGEwJVUzEiMCAGA1UEChMZR29vZ2xlIFRydXN0IFNlcnZpY2VzIExMQzEU\nMBIGA1UEAxMLR1RTIFJvb3QgUjQwHhcNMTYwNjIyMDAwMDAwWhcNMzYwNjIyMDAw\nMDAwWjBHMQswCQYDVQQGEwJVUzEiMCAGA1UEChMZR29vZ2xlIFRydXN0IFNlcnZp\nY2VzIExMQzEUMBIGA1UEAxMLR1RTIFJvb3QgUjQwdjAQBgcqhkjOPQIBBgUrgQQA\nIgNiAATzdHOnaItgrkO4NcWBMHtLSZ37wWHO5t5GvWvVYRg1rkDdc/eJkTBa6zzu\nhXyiQHY7qca4R9gq55KRanPpsXI5nymfopjTX15YhmUPoYRlBtHci8nHc8iMai/l\nxKvRHYqjQjBAMA4GA1UdDwEB/wQEAwIBBjAPBgNVHRMBAf8EBTADAQH/MB0GA1Ud\nDgQWBBSATNbrdP9JNqPV2Py1PsVq8JQdjDAKBggqhkjOPQQDAwNnADBkAjBqUFJ0\nCMRw3J5QdCHojXohw0+WbhXRIjVhLfoIN+4Zba3bssx9BzT1YBkstTTZbyACMANx\nsbqjYAuG7ZoIapVon+Kz4ZNkfF6Tpt95LY2F45TPI11xzPKwTdb+mciUqXWi4w==\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n"))
  (def %xc-ders (X509 from-pem %xc-pem))
  (write (list (List length %xc-ders) (Bytes same? (first %xc-ders) (Bytes of-hex "")))))
```
